title: Preet Panchal — About
description: I build apps and tools, with help from AI. None of my apps collects your data, runs analytics or tracks you.

title: Agitate | Shake to Develop
description: Agitate turns your iPhone into an instant camera. Take a photo, watch it print as a blank film card, then shake your phone to develop it. Everything stays on your device. Available on the App Store.

title: AuditWedge | SKU-Level Margin Audit
description: A deep dive into AuditWedge: the SKU-level margin-leak audit tool for e-commerce sellers.

title: Deflate | PDFs and Photos, Aimed at the Size You Were Asked For
description: Deflate compresses PDFs and images down to a size you name in kilobytes, then shows you the size it reached. Crop a passport photo to spec, make a scan searchable, merge, split, rotate — entirely on device, with no network code at all.
ogTitle: Deflate | PDFs and Photos, Aimed at the Size You Were Asked For

title: Deflate — Privacy Policy
description: Deflate privacy policy: no data collection, no servers, no trackers, no network code at all. Your documents never leave your device.

title: Deflate — Support
description: Help with Deflate: why a target size wasn't reached, why a multi-page PDF exported as several JPEGs, colour vs black & white, and how to get in touch.

title: DocFort | Digital Document Vault
description: A deep dive into DocFort: The privacy-first document vault for iPhone and iPad.

title: GeoLens | Geotagged Photos with an Audit Trail
description: GeoLens stamps every photo with coordinates, address, a map of the spot, and an EXIF audit trail. Built for surveyors, valuers, and field inspectors. Available on the App Store.
ogTitle: GeoLens | Geotagged Photos with an Audit Trail

title: GeoLens — Privacy Policy
description: GeoLens privacy policy: no data collection, no servers, no trackers. Your photos and location never reach us.

title: GeoLens — Terms of Use (EULA)
description: GeoLens terms of use: subscriptions, accuracy disclosures, and acceptable use.

title: Hello, Chain | An On-Chain Guestbook
description: Hello, Chain is an on-chain guestbook: write a short hello, sign it with Face ID or a fingerprint, and it is stored for good. No wallet, no crypto, no fees.

title: Preet Panchal — Builder
description: I build software that respects the people who use it — from privacy-first iOS apps to trust-first business tools.

title: The Hand Inside the Equation | Interactive Media Gallery
description: A live gallery of interactive media studies: marbling from its maths, light bending around a black hole, and your camera drawn in text. Each piece is checked against an independent reference.
ogTitle: The Hand Inside the Equation | Interactive Media Gallery

title: Get DocFort
description: Get DocFort, the privacy-first document vault for iPhone and iPad, on the App Store.

title: wake | A Living Drawing Instrument
description: wake is a generative-art instrument for the browser: thousands of line-heads move through fields of force across 100,000 designs and fifteen behaviours, six of them real physics and maths simulated from their equations.
